name: fade-through
title: Fade Through
description: A calm transition primitive that fades one layer out, passes through a wash, and reveals the next layer

variables.label: Wash
variables.description: Colour of the mid-transition frame. Paper resolves through --hf-fade-through-wash, accent rides --accent.

variables.label: Strength
variables.description: How far the wash covers at its peak. 1 is a full flash, 0.3 a light veil.

variables.label: Shape
variables.description: Flat fills the frame evenly, bloom concentrates the wash in the centre.
